errors.evidence: The Squared-Exponential line starts at approximately 52 at x=0, not 43. The reference confirms this (~52 at 0 demonstrations).
The Squared-Exponential line reaches approximately 55-56 at x=1500, and the reference says it rises above 55 at 250 and remains steady. The value of 57 is an overestimate.
The Tanh line appears to be blue (a medium or lighter blue), not grey, as shown in the figure and the reference description.

errors.evidence: The ELU line does not decrease to 44 at x=750; it stays around 46-47. The reference notes it shows little change from its starting point of ~46.
The LLaMA-2-chat-7B line is described as dashed magenta (dash-dot style) in the reference, not pink and dotted. The figure shows a pink/magenta dashed line.

errors.text_span: shows a constant value of approximately 43 across all values of x
errors.evidence: Looking at the figure, the LLaMA-2-chat-7B baseline appears to be around 43, which matches. However, looking more carefully at the y-axis scale (45-55), the dashed line appears to sit below 45, closer to 43. This is consistent.

The description does not mention that no lines intersect each other, and does not note that the Squared-Exponential line plateaus/remains steady after 250 demonstrations — instead suggesting a gradual increase to 1500.
